packageRules.description: Container image major version bumps (for example a Node major) can change runtime behavior; hold them for manual review instead of auto-merging.

nx-cache-server:latest (docker-compose.yml) is this repo's own image, built locally from apps/nx-cache-server/Dockerfile via docker-compose's build: field, not published to any registry Renovate can query; exclude it the way the fleet preset excludes other locally-built/LAN-only images.
